$comment: Rhymvex canonical design tokens. This file is the single source of truth. tokens.css is generated from it. Never hand-edit generated files.

black.role: Primary background — posts, reels covers, story templates, ad backgrounds

slate.role: Secondary backgrounds — cards, overlay panels, UI surfaces

white.role: Primary text on dark backgrounds; main headings and key UI text

volt.role: Primary accent — CTAs, buttons, key words, highlights, metrics

rule.comment: Black/Slate + White + Volt (± Ember). Volt is accent/CTA only. Ember is urgency only.

logo.clearSpace: at least the height of the letter R on all sides
